description: Tall and gracefully proportioned, the Mackenzie Chest offers substantial storage in a vertical footprint that's perfect for nurseries where floor space is precious. Dovetailed drawers with smooth full-extension glides keep clothing and accessories neatly organized and easy to reach. Solid hardwood construction with a warm Brown Maple finish ensures lasting beauty and durability. Coordinates with the full Mackenzie collection. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish.
